name: Naka-Itabashi
tagline: Shinjuku in 21 minutes and Shibuya in 26 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Itabashi City, served by Tobu Tojo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 32 minutes to Otemachi, 21 minutes to Shinjuku, 26 minutes to Shibuya and 47 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 22.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 6.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 22.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 20 m to 26.8 m, a difference of 6.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 1 clinic and 2 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 豊島病院, about 12 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 日本大学医学部付属板橋病院, about 13 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tobu Tojo Line.
congestion: Tobu Tojo Line runs at 131% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 北池袋→池袋, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 5 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tobu Tojo Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
